status: PROPOSED — no source approved, no text authorised for import
failClosedRationale: A source with no recorded decision is 'blocked'. The Hadith Commentary Source Register v01 states it directly: 'The absence of a displayed license is NOT permission to copy the content.' So absence of a decision must deny, never permit. A source becomes 'embed-cleared' only by a recorded grant with a date and a citable term — never by a reviewer's impression that reuse is probably fine.

rightsStateMeanings.blocked: No text may be stored, displayed, indexed or redistributed, and the app may not fetch, link to or reference this source on any user-facing surface. Every permission flag is false. This is the default and the state every unreviewed source holds.
rightsStateMeanings.link-only: The app may present a clearly attributed OUTBOUND link and may store the URL, the bibliographic citation and the locator. It may NOT store, display, cache or index the source's text.
rightsStateMeanings.embed-cleared: Text may be stored and displayed, bounded by the recorded grant's own conditions. Requires a non-null rightsEvidence.grant.

vocabularyReconciliation.note: The Master Plan v01 §3.3 names the states 'licensed', 'link-only' and 'blocked'. The Start Prompt v03 §6, which is one day newer, names them 'link-only', 'embed-cleared' and 'blocked'. This manifest uses the Start Prompt's three as canonical.
vocabularyReconciliation.reason: 'embed-cleared' states what the app is permitted to DO. 'licensed' states something about the source, and a source can carry a licence that still does not permit embedding in this app. The verb is the safer name.

importAuthorisation.approvedSourcesNote: A DIFFERENT, source-level mechanism from approvedCollections/approvedEditions below — HadeethEnc is a single curated encyclopedia, not one of the classical editions those two lists gate the commentary-occurrence-id-minting rule for (see the H1 guard's own 'no commentary row claims a narration occurrence' check). Owner grant, 2026-09-26 (docs/governance/2026-09-26-owner-decisions.md, row 5): 'Do b' — real HadeethEnc text, unmodified and attributed.
importAuthorisation.consequence: hadeethenc is cleared for real, unmodified, attributed text import (approvedSources above). Every OTHER source stays blocked or link-only, and no classical edition is approved for the commentary-binding mechanism (approvedCollections/approvedEditions stay empty) — so the Collections tab's book/chapter model and the Islamweb/Sunnah.com commentary pilot still run on SYNTHETIC FIXTURES. This is not a limitation to work around; it is the source approval gate holding, exactly as the Master Plan requires, for every source that has not itself been granted.
